content_sections.heading: About NIT Patna
content_sections.text: National Institute of Technology Patna is on Ashok Rajpath, Patna, Bihar. The notice describes it as an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Education, Govt. of India. This position is in its Department of Chemical Science and Technology and works under Principal Investigator Dr. Subrata Das, Associate Professor.

content_sections.heading: NIT Patna Project Associate/JRF Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Nationality: Indian nationals only. Qualification: M. Sc. in Chemistry/ Applied Chemistry/ Analytical Chemistry/ Medicinal Chemistry and other similar domains. Qualifying examination: Selection is based on the National Eligibility Test (NET) CSIR/UGC, including LS/JRF, or GATE. The application form also asks for the branch, year, percentile (with score) and All India Rank of the examination you passed. Experience: Experience certificates are to be submitted if you have any. The form has space for teaching, research or industrial experience. For the full eligibility details, see the official notification and the ANRF guidelines it names, ANRF/OM/N/01/2024 and SB/S9/Z-06/2019.

content_sections.heading: Job Description and Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Work: The PA/JRF will work on the broader areas of research and development relating to the project. Duration: One year. The position will be upgraded based on satisfactory performance. Ph.D.: The PA/JRF may be allowed to join the Ph.D. programme, subject to the eligibility criteria of NIT Patna, Bihar, India. Place of work: Department of Chemical Science and Technology, NIT Patna. Travel: No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected through a walk-in interview held in offline mode. Selection is based on CSIR/UGC NET, including LS/JRF, or GATE, following the ANRF guidelines.

faq.question: Q1. When and where is the NIT Patna PA/JRF walk-in interview?
faq.answer: It is on 20 November 2026 at 11:00 am, in offline mode. The venue is the Dept. of Chemical Science and Technology, NIT Patna, Ashok Rajpath, Bihar 800005.

faq.question: Q2. How many positions are there?
faq.answer: There is one position, printed in the notice as PA/JRF (01).

faq.question: Q3. What is the monthly pay?
faq.answer: The emoluments are Rs. 37,000/- plus HRA as admissible by ANRF, for one year.

faq.question: Q4. Which M. Sc. subjects are accepted?
faq.answer: The notice accepts M. Sc. in Chemistry, Applied Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Medicinal Chemistry and other similar domains.

faq.question: Q5. Is NET or GATE required?
faq.answer: Yes. Selection is based on CSIR/UGC NET, including LS/JRF, or GATE, as per ANRF's MOs ANRF/OM/N/01/2024 and SB/S9/Z-06/2019.

faq.question: Q6. Can I send my application by email?
faq.answer: Yes. You can send your CV in advance to [email protected]. All documents still have to be handed in to Dr. Subrata Das at the interview.

faq.question: Q7. Can the JRF join a Ph.D. at NIT Patna?
faq.answer: The PA/JRF may be allowed to join the Ph.D. programme, subject to NIT Patna's eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: It is for one year. The position will be upgraded based on satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q9. Will travel costs for the interview be paid?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. What is the research project about?
faq.answer: The project is "Metallacalix[n]arene supramolecular complexes with pyrimidine nucleobases for catalytic applications". It is sponsored by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation, New Delhi.
